documents.content: A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.

skill.content: Check the bound callback delivery record, correlate order version and event ID. FAILED/503 suggests a delivery failure. Never resend or modify permissions.
